name: gdrive
title: Google Drive
description: Files from Drive — a whole drive or one folder of it — downloaded, indexed, and written back unless the source is read-only. Needs a Google connection.

permission.google.drive.read.why: List and read the files of the configured folder.

permission.google.drive.write.why: Write back into the configured folder: create and update files, move removed ones to the trash.

drive.label: Shared drive
drive.hint: Pick from the drives this Google account can see, or type its ID. Leave empty to sync My Drive. Syncing several drives? Add one source per drive.

path.label: Folder
path.hint: A folder of that drive, by its path. Only what is under it is synced, and written back. Leave empty for the whole drive.

cache_root.label: Cache folder
cache_root.hint: Where downloaded bytes land. Defaults to this instance's own directory.
